objective: Rethink layout to display mascots prominently as BACKGROUND images (not small icons), preserving original PNGs in public/mascots/ (hestia.png 2.2MB, pluto.png 2.3MB) - must NOT be modified/optimized/resized

history.action: Feature initialized by Zeus. Delegating to Hera for new spec addressing mascot backgrounds.

Hera completed 5-step discovery: (1) Intenção: identidade visual + reconhecimento módulo; (2) Jornada: background por estado (vazio/carregando/erro=proeminente, com dados=watermark), cross-fade módulos; (3) Regras: CSS vars + content-visibility + LQIP, prefers-reduced-motion, PNGs intactos; (4) YAGNI: milon, otimização PNGs, temas, animações complexas, SW, interatividade fora; (5) Alternativas: A (CSS vars+Context) recomendada vs B (Framer Motion) vs C (next/image - bloqueada). Spec.md escrito.
Human approved spec (approve-spec). Transitioning to PLAN_READY.

Atena produced plan.md + tasks.json (7 tasks, DAG valid). Architecture: CSS vars + Context + CSS transitions + LQIP. Tasks cover: CSS foundation, Provider/hook, Login, Dashboard, Pluto pages, cleanup, a11y verification.
Zeus validated tasks.json DAG (7 tasks, acyclic, criteria testable). Ready for Minos (contract tests) → Hefesto (impl) loop starting with task-1-css-foundation.

task-1-css-foundation: Minos wrote 21 contract tests (RED). Hefesto implemented lib/hestia/mascot-lqip.ts, components/ui/MascotBackground.tsx, app/globals.css. Blocked by toHaveStyle asymmetric matcher limitation. Minos fixed test assertions. All 21 tests GREEN. lint + build pass.

decisions: Background por estado (C): vazio/carregando/erro=proeminente, com dados=watermark 10-15%
CSS Variables + Context + CSS Transitions + content-visibility + LQIP (B)
PNGs originais 2.2MB/2.3MB intocados — servidos estaticamente de /public/mascots/
YAGNI: milon, otimização, temas, animações complexas, SW, lazy-load avançado, interatividade
Alternativa A selecionada: CSS vars (--mascot-bg) + MascotProvider existente + CSS transitions nativas
Overlay: ::before pseudo-element, 70% dark, white text — WCAG AA
